llama_arch_fused_rejected_with: llama_model_load: error loading model: check_tensor_dims: tensor 'blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight' not found
why: the llama arch does not call create_tensor_gate_up_exps (src/models/llama.cpp:78-80): it creates ffn_gate_exps / ffn_up_exps directly and passes flags=0 for ffn_up_exps, i.e. required. So a llama-arch file carrying only ffn_gate_up_exps cannot load at all, and the fused form is testable only on an arch that calls the helper.
